name: hts-code-lookup
title: HTS Code Lookup: US Tariff Rates & Duty Search (USITC)
description: Look up US HTS codes in the official USITC Harmonized Tariff Schedule by code or product description. Get general, special and column 2 duty rates (inherited down to 10-digit lines), full descriptions, units and Chapter 99 references. Misses are free status rows.
